name: iroh-quic-loopback-baseline
purpose: Measure a relay-free Iroh/QUIC endpoint pair on loopback and verify direct addressing, framed echo and reconnect
steps: Build the pinned iroh 1.4.1 probe from research/iroh-probe
Bind two endpoints to 127.0.0.1 with RelayMode::Disabled
Connect the client to the server by EndpointId plus direct address
Echo bounded binary payloads on bidirectional QUIC streams
Close the connection and reconnect to measure setup cost
